layers.description: Embedded ASM 9.x bytecode manipulation framework for reading, writing, and transforming Java class files. All bytecode parsing across the project depends on this library.

layers.name: Bytecode Frontends
layers.description: Alternative front-end compilers that consume Java bytecode: j2ll (bytecode to LLVM IR) and B2C (bytecode to C). Each includes ASM visitor helpers, graph IR data structures, and output generation.

layers.name: Core JIT Compiler
layers.description: Main JVM bytecode to native x86 machine code compiler pipeline. Includes bytecode parsing (BCClass/BCMethod), intermediate representation (IM code graph), compilation orchestration (StaticCompiler), symbol tables, persistent entries, virtual method tables, and compiler plugins for low-level OS operations.

layers.name: x86 Code Generation Backend
layers.description: Native x86 code emission, register allocation, and binary code generation. Handles IA32 instruction selection, register management (general, float, double, 64-bit), operand tracking, and dynamic/static binary code output for multiple architectures.

layers.name: Platform Abstractions & Utilities
layers.description: Zero OS kernel interfaces (memory, CPU, scheduler, portals, naming), memory emulation for host-JVM testing, custom lightweight collections, component specification parser, binary format readers/writers (little-endian), and ZIP utilities.

layers.name: Native C Runtime
layers.description: C implementations of Java standard library native methods (java.io, java.lang, java.util, etc.) and JNode kernel services. Each .c file bridges JVM calls to native OS operations via a runtime interface.

layers.name: Compiled Output
layers.description: Generated intermediate representation output from compilation. Contains .imcode and .ll files representing compiled Java classes. These are artifacts consumed by the ISO builder for the final boot image.

layers.name: GUI Launcher & Tests
layers.description: Swing-based graphical launcher for the compiler and JUnit test infrastructure testing the ASM library and compiler components.

tour.title: Compiler Entry Point
tour.description: Start at the main GUI class to understand the compiler boot flow. Compiler.java is a JFrame that provides a project explorer and buttons to compile, run the OS, and open projects. The 'Compile' action delegates to jx.compiler.CompileNative, which orchestrates the full bytecode-to-native pipeline.

tour.title: Class File & Execution Environment
tour.description: Explore how Java .class files are loaded and modeled. BCClass represents a parsed class, BCMethod represents a method, and BCMethodWithCode carries the bytecode. The execenv package provides the execution environment interface (IOSystem, TypeMap, BinaryCode, BytecodeInputStream) that the rest of the compiler depends on.

tour.title: Intermediate Code (IMCode) Graph
tour.description: The IMCode layer is the core intermediate representation. Bytecode is translated into a graph of IMNode instances: arithmetic ops (IMAdd, IMSub, IMMul, etc.), control flow (IMBranch, IMGoto, IMConditionalBranch, IMReturn), object operations (IMNew, IMGetField, IMPutField, IMInvoke), and more. IMBasicBlock structures the control flow graph.

tour.title: Native Code Backend (x86)
tour.description: BinaryCodeIA32 is the assembler that emits native x86 machine code. It manages a byte array of instructions, a symbol table for unresolved references, and exception handlers. Supporting classes handle register allocation (RegManager, Reg), operands (Opr, Ref), and floating-point registers (RegDouble, RegFloat). Parallel backends exist for ARM (BinaryCodeDynamicARM) and RISC-V (BinaryCodeDynamicRiscV).

tour.title: Symbol Tables & Virtual Method Tables
tour.description: The symbols package defines SymbolTableEntryBase and its subclasses (e.g., InternalAddrSTEntry, MethodeDescSTEntry, StackMapSTEntry) that record unresolved addresses and relocations during compilation. The vtable package implements the virtual method dispatch mechanism — ClassFactory builds class metadata, MethodTable manages dispatch tables, and InterfaceMethodTable handles interface dispatch.

tour.title: LLVM IR Compilation Pipeline
tour.description: A second, alternative compilation path translates bytecode directly to LLVM IR. B2IR is the main entry, using ASM's ClassReader/ClassNode for class parsing. The IRBuilder handles instruction translation, while j2ll/graph/ defines the IR data structures (IrBlock, IrFunction, IrSentence, IrVariable). The inst/ subdirectory contains typed IR instructions (IrCall, IrStore, IrLoad, IrArith, IrBranch1/2). Output is written as .ll files that can be compiled by LLVM.

tour.title: Legacy Bytecode-to-C Translation
tour.description: An even older translation path converts bytecode to C source code. B2C.java defines field layout offsets for Java runtime classes (String, Class, Thread, etc.), then uses j2c/ helpers (CBuilder, AssistLLVM, MV, CV) to emit C code that mirrors Java semantics. This pipeline connects to the LLVM path through common helper classes (CV, MV, JSignature are duplicated in both j2ll/asm/ and com/ebsee/j2c/).

tour.title: C Runtime Library
tour.description: The C runtime implements native methods for Java standard library classes. Each .c file corresponds to a Java class (e.g., java.lang.Object.c, java.lang.String.c, java.io.PrintStream.c). Functions follow a naming convention (bridge_ or func_ prefix) and interact with the JX zero-kernel runtime (metadata.c/h provides the string table, class metadata, and constant pool data embedded in the OS image).
